summary: P0/P1 Reaction GIF Creator Access Control Frontend Testing - 12/12 tests PASSED. Fixed critical JS error (canAccessFull before initialization). Admin user correctly gets full access (no watermark, no paywall for Download/Share/Copy/Right-click). Frontend correctly shows watermark badge 'Preview · Subscribe to download' for free users only
Frontend correctly blocks Download/Share to Story/Copy Link/Right-click with paywall modal for free users
Frontend correctly blocks Ctrl+S (download) and Ctrl+C (copy) keyboard shortcuts for free users
Waiting feature panel with 4 CTA buttons (Story Video, Photo to Comic, Comic Story Book, Bedtime Stories) visible during generation
